text:
marie: Heads-up thread — finalize webinar runbook today. Title proposal: 'Predictable Inference: practical knobs for latency, cost, and reliability'
ben: I like it. Let's make sure demos show Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoffs. people should leave with a one-page decision checklist.
tara: speakers: ben for framing + decision checklist (4m), zack live demo (10m), me for numbers + routing (5m), marie close & CTA (1m)
zack: demo plan: short chat flow then a rerank pass that improves answer selection. prefer Dedicated for the live run but will have recorded variant. will include console trace showing token breakdown.
marie: can we get a pre-warm script and creds into the vault? also need a 30s fallback clip recorded.
ben: abstract draft: "A practical framework for choosing serving modes and concrete tuning—batching, KV cache, quantization—plus a live rerank demo and routing patterns for production apps."
tara: i'll build the benchmark slide: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and estimated $/1M tokens for Hosted vs Dedicated. keep it simple.
zack: fallback: record the rerank + screen trace. if live fails, cut to video and narrate differences between modes.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: rehearsal scheduled: Tue 11:00-11:30 PT in #marketing-rehearsals
marie: run-of-show 20m exact: 
```
- 0:00-0:00:45 welcome + logistics (marie)
- 0:00:45-0:04:30 decision checklist + when-to-pick (ben)
- 0:04:30-0:14:30 live demo: chat -> rerank (zack)
- 0:14:30-0:19:30 benchmarks + ops tips (tara)
- 0:19:30-0:20:00 CTA, lead routing note (marie)
```
ben: routing rule idea: demo requests & >2k tokens/mo -> AE, all others -> SDR. add checkbox "compliance/regulatory" to route to enterprise.
tara: i'll add that to the follow-up form and the CSV mapping. also will include a short survey question about workload type (chat, embeddings, rerank).marie: design, can you make a 1-slide decision visual by EOD? we'll need light/dark variants. @design-team
zack: will provide pre-warm curl and demo creds. example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/instances/prewarm -d '{"model":"demo-chat","len":128}'`
marie: rehearsal checklist: mic test, screen share order, demo creds, pre-warm, fallback clip queued, backup laptop. pls ACK.
ben: ack — will rehearse transitions with zack. no real customer data in demo.
tara: ack — will bring the cost slide and CSV workflow.
ops-bot: :spiral_note_pad: follow-up doc template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar-followup-2334
marie: great work. we'll do the dry run Tue 11 and go live Thu. I'll update the invite with assets and attach the fallback clip.
